# Copilot instructions

Read `/AGENTS.md` and `/docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md` before proposing or applying repository changes.

The execution plan is the only canonical source for the Laravel + native Android rebuild. Work against a stable task ID, preserve legacy data identifiers, verify the result, and update the plan/status log in the same change. Never mark a task complete without recorded evidence, and never commit secrets or generated local environment files.
